system.longDesc:
Cost: 4 SP

NOTE: You may only choose stunts from this list when you earn the SP while making a melee attack.

Convert up to 3 points of damage you would inflict on your foe with this attack into a penalty to their worn armor instead, based on the type of damage you dealt. This penalty lasts for 1d6 rounds or until they take a major action to readjust their armor, whichever comes first.
